winning_plan: To improve the Factorization Machine baseline, we introduce user behavioral history sequences by extracting the last 20 interacted video IDs for each user from training and validation logs. These historical video IDs are embedded via a dedicated lookup table and mean-pooled into a user interest vector, which is concatenated with the existing categorical features. We train this sequence-augmented Factorization Machine using multi-seed ensembling (seeds `[42, 123, 2024]`) to capture sequential user intent and improve ranking performance. Finally, we evaluate the ensemble on the validation split and export the predictions to the required submission format.
